# Accounts Memorandum — Term Length, Billing Frequency, Payment Terms and Late Fee Rates of the Building Automation Service Plans

For invoicing the Building Automation Service Plans the accounts office applies the following per-tier terms: the length of one plan term in calendar months, how the annual plan fee is invoiced, the number of calendar days from invoice date to due date, and the late fee on an overdue invoice per month, expressed as a percentage per month.

| Tier | Term (calendar months) | Billing frequency | Payment terms (calendar days) | Late fee (percent per month) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | 12 | annual | 30 | 1.5 |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | 12 | semiannual | 30 | 1.5 |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | 12 | quarterly | 30 | 1.5 |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | 24 | quarterly | 30 | 1.5 |
| Remote Optimization Plan | 24 | monthly | 30 | 1.25 |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | 36 | monthly | 45 | 1.0 |

Memorandum notes:

- The three lower tiers run twelve-month terms; the Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan and the Remote Optimization Plan run 24 months; the Integrated Building Automation Partnership runs 36 months.
- Billing frequency is the frequency at which the annual plan fee is invoiced: annual means one invoice a year, semiannual two, quarterly four and monthly twelve.
- Payment terms are 30 calendar days at every tier except the Integrated Building Automation Partnership, where they are 45 days.
- The late fee rate is 1.5 percent per month at the four lower tiers, 1.25 percent per month under the Remote Optimization Plan and 1.0 percent per month under the Integrated Building Automation Partnership.
